findings.evidence: "The people operations office tracks the stipend budget at the start of the fiscal year. Staff can request a printed copy from the benefits team at any time. Also, you submit the request in the portal."
findings.violation: This duplicates content from lines 4-8, repeating the same budget tracking and copy request statements that already appear in the Program Overview.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicated sentences from the Special Cases section and replace with unique content that actually addresses special cases, or delete this redundant section entirely.

findings.evidence: "In addition, eligibility for the workspace stipend depends on several details the reviewer checks one at a time. The workspace must sit inside the employee's primary residence for the stipend to apply. A workspace located in a shared coworking space does not qualify for the stipend under this section. A workspace used only occasionally for calls does not meet the bar the stipend policy sets. The reviewer confirms the workspace address matches the address already on file with payroll. A workspace shared with a roommate can still qualify if the desk area belongs to the employee alone. The stipend covers only the equipment placed inside that confirmed workspace, nothing located elsewhere in the home. A workspace that changes address during the benefit year needs a fresh confirmation before the stipend continues. The reviewer logs every workspace confirmation in the same shared tracking sheet the benefits team maintains. A workspace confirmation from more than one year ago no longer satisfies the stipend requirement on its own."
findings.violation: This section uses excessive nesting and repetition, making a list of conditions feel like a paragraph. Each condition is separated by a sentence rather than using a structured list format.
findings.fix: Convert this into a bulleted or numbered list to improve readability and make each eligibility criterion clear at a glance.

findings.evidence: "Similarly, the policy applies to one device per category per employee whenever the benefits team confirms that the role genuinely requires a second device because fieldwork regularly takes the employee away from the single fixed desk that the standard equipment list assumes every applicant has for the whole benefit year while the finance office tracks the second device against the same annual amount that the equipment catalog publishes for each category."
findings.violation: This sentence is grammatically complex and nearly impossible to parse, with multiple dependent clauses and unclear relationships between concepts.
findings.fix: Break this into two or three shorter sentences that clearly explain when a second device is approved and how it is tracked separately.

findings.evidence: "You record the stipend item on the request form. Finance reconciles the stipend item against the request log each month. Payroll releases the stipend item amount after that monthly review. Also, you submit the request in the portal. You track its status there until the payment clears."
findings.violation: Key terminology is defined here but these terms (stipend item, request form, portal, request log) are used throughout the document before being defined.
findings.fix: Move the Terminology Notes section to appear before the How to Apply section, or integrate the definitions inline where these terms first appear.

findings.evidence: "Then, the employee reviews the confirmation summary before submitting the final request."
findings.violation: The term "confirmation summary" is unclear without prior definition; it is never defined anywhere in the document.
findings.fix: Replace with a clearer description, such as "the employee reviews a summary of the submitted equipment and cost details before submitting the final request."

findings.evidence: "The people operations office tracks the stipend budget at the start of the fiscal year. Every entry carries a date stamp so the record stays easy to audit."
findings.violation: This duplicates lines 7-8, which appear in the Program Overview section.
findings.fix: Replace this duplicated content with genuinely new information about how employees can ask questions or receive updates about the stipend policy.
